summary: Valens Semiconductor Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing that shareholders approved all proposals at the annual general meeting held July 30, 2026, by the required majority under Israeli law. Approximately 37.35% of outstanding ordinary shares were represented. This is a routine post-meeting disclosure of ordinary corporate governance items, not a special-situation event. No specific proposals, transaction terms, or strategic actions were detailed in the excerpt. The filing incorporates the 6-K into existing F-3 and S-8 registration statements. There are no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb considerations; the event is simply the formal announcement of AGM results.
